metadata.project: Large-Scale Telecommunication Data Processing and Performance Monitoring Using MapReduce
metadata.phase: Phase 6: Network Performance Monitoring & CDR Anomaly Detection
metadata.methodology: Robust Non-Parametric Median & MAD Anomaly Scoring (Modified Z-score)
metadata.disclaimer: All detected anomalies represent empirical statistical deviations in CDR traffic volume and do not indicate confirmed physical equipment outages or network hardware failures.
